limitations: The full Pseudo-Two-Dimensional (P2D) electrochemical model is highly complex and typically requires specialized solvers (e.g., PyBaMM or COMSOL) which are computationally heavy to implement from scratch in a short script. A simplified Electrochemical-Aging-Thermal (ECAT) surrogate model based on Equivalent Circuit principles coupled with OCV and thermal dynamics was implemented to demonstrate the end-to-end MMGA framework.
